title.narrative: 1.1.1.1 Number of acts and regulations, rules, notifications, policies developed, reviewed to better comply with International Labour Standards disaggregated by type

description.narrative: 1.1.1.1 Number of acts and regulations, rules, notifications, policies developed, reviewed to better comply with International Labour Standards disaggregated by type

comment.narrative: . 5 draft labour laws for ICT were reviewed. 3 Labour protection frameworks drafted. 2 LPF adopted Punjab KP 1 LPF in process of approval Sindh. 11 sets of rules of business drafted for Sindh and submitted to the government year 3 2 set of laws on freedom of association and collective bargaining and labour dispute resolution reviewed The hiring of consultants for the drafting of the rules of business for OSH law recently passed in the KP province has started the rules will be developed in the next reporting year The hiring of consultants for reviewing the Punjab Labour laws and consolidating them under one major law that is compliant to ILS has started the first draft will be prepared in the next reporting year The work on recommendations from the FoACB and further research in this regard has been commissioned and will be completed in the next reporting year.
